items.claim: D3SortableDemo's "index" order sorted ids as strings, so bar-10 and bar-11 stood third and fourth
DiagramLayoutDemo dropped the routes a layout run reports
DiagramDropDemo let a note be dragged into the row although a palette drop refuses it
ClipDemo's load check used a binder that accepts every event name, so the clip then threw inside the effect
CompoundPathsDemo's honk button didn't follow the goose during a drag
AudioDemo kept a stolen looping source voice as "playing"
items.note: Its test is in `AudioDemo.browser.test.tsx` and has not been run.

items.claim: AnimationDemo's momentum bounds allowed for a 60-px card while its cards are 80 px wide
CustomShaderDemo registered the mark texture once for every mount that started before the image loaded
BidiDemo threw on long input by spreading every code point into one call
